description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named HistoryAdapter used to display a list of calculation history entries in an Android app. It handles creation and binding of view holders, manages item interactions such as toggling favorites and removing entries, and programmatically creates UI components for each history item.

classes.name: HistoryAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter class for displaying calculation history entries with functionality for toggling favorites and deleting entries.

classes.name: HistoryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to views for each history item, including timestamp, expression, result, and favorite button.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder components, setting up all UI elements programmatically.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder for a given position, updating UI elements and setting click listeners.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of history entries.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the list at the specified position and notifies the adapter.
